cli.accept: python integration/research/verified_patch_install/install_verified_patch.py accept --prepared <research/install_job/prepared.json> --reload-task <fresh UnifiedSkyrim/validation/PASS_installed_reload_task> --aux-reload-task <required FC triangle reload task>

requirements: All rev3 producer, independent binary, full active-context, profile topology, exact private-copy, ordering, and fresh typed-reload gates remain mandatory.
Before any journal mutation, install_started.json stores the complete original file rows, exact backups, candidate unit, installer PID, and preparation SHA.
recover is an explicit command for a rev4 process-interrupted attempt; it is never an automatic resume and never authorizes acceptance.

Recovery refuses live PIDs, terminal receipts, legacy incomplete snapshots, changed prepared inputs or staged files, unexpected file bytes, shared destinations, unexpected journal occupants, and mismatched prior-row events.
Recovery restores every previous byte and original file row, removes only the interrupted new unit, preserves event history, and renames install_started.json to recovered_attempt.json.

The persistent install.lock uses a Windows byte lock while an operation runs. operation_finished means the callback has returned or raised, not that installation was accepted. An unfinished lock requires explicit recovery.
Reprepare after successful recovery rather than rerunning the interrupted attempt. An installed candidate still requires a fresh read-only typed reload before accept.

actual_child_process_crashes: after final copy and before its journal update
verification.scope: All 29 crash/rollback checks mutate only research fixtures. FC preparation, installation, dual fresh reloads and acceptance have separate immutable receipts.

limits: Legacy rev3 interrupted attempts lack original_file_rows and still require manual inspection; rev4 does not guess their original journal state.
A crash during an individual private-copy temporary write is not claimed to be covered by the between-copy fixtures.
Final full VFS/resource graph, regenerated Synthesis/LOD and game validation remain separate gates. No game was started.
change: Retains rev4 crash recovery and immutable receipts; adds optional profile preference pinning and a mandatory FC triangle companion reload for acceptance.
